A tool that found nothing and a tool that never looked produce identical output.

Across 62 resolved engagements the dominant failure was never a missing technique. It was a measurement that was wrong, producing output that was indistinguishable from a result. Every case below shipped well-formed output. Not one of them errored.

62engagements resolved
34instrument defects catalogued
13retrieval hazards catalogued
0looked like an error

Why this matters more than a missing technique

A missing technique is visible. The run stops, the report says not attempted, and the gap is in the coverage list where somebody will read it. A broken measurement is invisible. It produces a complete, well-formed, plausible answer, and the answer is wrong in the direction that makes the engagement look finished.

Of the nine instruments the corpus tallies, six would have deleted a finding that existed and three would have invented one. A negative result is the only output nobody cross-checks — which is exactly why the defect has to be ruled out from outside the output.

The three questions every negative must answer

#QuestionIf unanswered Discriminator
1Did the tool work? An oracle that cannot fire reports absence Force a positive through it, before believing any negative
2Did it look where it needed to? A blind spot reads as an absent service A work count: rows, bytes, candidates, addresses
3Is the failure the target’s and not mine? Real findings get deleted and filed as clean Change one variable, or probe a known-good reference

They are ordered, not interchangeable. A green positive control with a zero work count still fails — the control may have fired on a code path the target never takes.

Quick path

  1. Read the 34 corrections. The failures that recur, cheapest first. Every entry names the lab that produced it.
  2. Check your instrument against the 13 retrieval hazards. These are correct instruments pointed at the wrong question — the class that still returns a clean negative.
  3. Run the three questions above before writing any negative. All three, in order, with the discriminator attached.
  4. Then look up the lab. The index carries the class and the discriminator that settled it; the resolution map says which single measurement closed each one.

Next step

If you are about to write the words not present, no results, or not exploitable, stop and read the evidence discipline first. That page is the long form of the sentence at the top of this one.

The markdown in the repository is the authority. This site is a rendering of it. Where the two disagree, the repository is correct and this page is wrong — report it as a build defect, not as a finding.

Target-internal paths, container addresses and cookie identifiers are redacted in this rendering. The repository markdown is unredacted.

Counts on this site are read out of the source files at build time, and the renderer is markdown-it-py. Nothing on this page was written by hand except this footer, the homepage and the stylesheet.
